remarks: Recently renovated 3 bedroom, 2 1/2 bath Cape Cod-style home in the Glenville section of Greenwich, CT.  All new hardwood floors, new stainless steel and granite kitchen with bamboo floor, huge rear deck with natural gas BBQ (house gas) and a first floor master bedroom w/bath. Living room has a coffered ceiling and fireplace with a new porch. Bath #1 has new luxury shower while bath #2 has a Jacuzzi tub. W/D in laundry room and one-car garage in basement.
